name: Kijcharoen Engineering Electric Public Company Limited
summary: Kijcharoen Engineering Electric Public Company Limited operates in Thailand, specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of a range of electrical infrastructure products. Its core offerings include comprehensive electrical systems, robust electrical cabinets and enclosures, and functional electrical cable trays. Additionally, the company provides bespoke sheet metal fabrication and supplies automated kiosk solutions. Its headquarters are located in Krathum Baen, Thailand.
